note: Frozen before any model runs. Do not edit: a changed prompt invalidates every arm scored before it. Checks are yes/no questions a vision model answers; a score is a count, never an opinion.

params.steps: per arm, the model's recommended turbo step count, recorded in the arm's result file

prompts.prompt: A plain white storefront sign on a brick wall, with the words OPEN 24 HOURS in black capital letters, centered and clearly legible.

checks.q: Do the words 'OPEN 24 HOURS' appear in the image, spelled exactly, in capital letters?
Is all of the text inside a single sign on a wall?

prompts.prompt: A red coffee mug on a wooden table with 'COFFEE' printed on it in white letters.

checks.q: Does the mug show the word 'COFFEE' spelled exactly?
Is the printed text white against red?

prompts.prompt: A yellow road warning sign with the number '55' printed large and centered, next to a road.

checks.q: Does the sign show the number '55' and no other number?

prompts.prompt: Exactly five red apples in a row on a plain wooden table, nothing else on the table.

checks.q: Is the table otherwise empty of other objects?

prompts.prompt: Three blue balloons tied with strings, floating against a plain grey sky.
Two paper cups on a desk beside one closed notebook.
A blue square on the left and a red circle on the right, both on a white background.

checks.q: Is the blue square to the left of the red circle?
Is the shape on the left a square?
Is the shape on the right a circle?

prompts.prompt: A cat sitting on top of a wooden crate, with a dog standing on the floor below and to the left of the crate.

checks.q: Is the cat above the crate?
Is the dog below the crate?
Is the dog to the left of the crate?

prompts.prompt: Three books stacked vertically: the top book is green, the middle is blue, the bottom is red.
A photo of a young woman with green hair wearing a yellow raincoat, standing in rain.

checks.q: Is it raining in the image?

prompts.prompt: A vintage car painted deep purple, parked in front of a white building with blue shutters.
Two bottles side by side: the left one is orange liquid, the right one is clear water.

checks.q: Is the left bottle's contents orange?
Is the right bottle's contents colourless or clear?

prompts.prompt: A beach at sunset with an empty sky, no birds and no airplanes anywhere in the image.
A cup of black coffee on a saucer, with no spoon and no sugar cube in the scene.

checks.q: Is there a sugar cube visible?

prompts.prompt: A snow-covered pine tree in a field, with no people and no buildings anywhere in the image.
A busy farmers market at midday, people browsing stalls of vegetables, warm sunlight.
An astronaut standing on a rocky alien hillside under two moons, dust in the air.
A close-up portrait of an elderly fisherman with a weathered face, shallow depth of field, natural light.
